description:
Cross-platform advanced subtitle editor

Aegisub is a free, cross-platform open source tool for creating and modifying subtitles. Aegisub makes it quick and easy to time subtitles to audio, and features many powerful tools for styling them, including a built-in real-time video preview.
Aegisub 3.5.0 adds video panning and zooming, much better High-DPI support, prompts to keep a script's resolution and color matrix in sync with its video, a reworked video position marker in the audio display, and native Apple Silicon builds, along with many fixes. Windows and macOS builds are now signed.
The changelog can be found here.
Security: This release fixes CVE-2026-92705: opening a crafted subtitle file could run arbitrary code through Automation scripts it references. All users should upgrade. Thanks to shavitush for reporting it. This release also hardens Aegisub against other maliciously crafted files.
